description_expanded: Salt Grove Cottage - Near Beach Home with Community Pool in Watersound Favorite Features: - Community Amenities - Complimentary Bikes - Private Community Beach Access More About Salt Grove Cottage: Escape to this spacious and stylish 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom vacation rental located in the heart of WaterSound along Florida’s scenic 30A. Perfect for families or groups, this beautifully designed coastal retreat offers the ideal blend of comfort, convenience, and luxury. Enjoy an open-concept living area, fully equipped kitchen, and private ensuite bedrooms that provide plenty of space to relax after a day in the sun. Guests love the resort-style amenities, including access to a refreshing community pool and miles of picturesque walking and biking paths throughout WaterSound. Complimentary bikes are included, making it easy to explore nearby 30A beach towns, local shops, and delicious dining options. The area’s sugar-white sand beaches and emerald waters are just minutes away, offering endless opportunities for swimming, sunbathing, and unforgettable sunsets. Whether you’re planning a family beach getaway, a couples’ retreat, or a group vacation, this WaterSound 30A rental delivers everything you need for a memorable stay. With its prime location, upscale features, and access to top community amenities, this home is the perfect destination for your next coastal escape.
